map.产品名和商标是一回事吗？: Is a product name the same as a trademark?
map.不是。产品名可用于宣传，但要在对应类目注册商标才受保护；生成后请查近似商标，避免: No. A product name can be used in marketing, but it is only protected once registered as a trademark in the relevant class; after generating, search for similar trademarks to avoid an opposition after launch.
